Ficum Blu is a celebration of the Italian lifestyle, represented as a basket brimming with ripe fruit: resting on a structured ground of patchouli lie the citrusy notes of Italian lemon and mandarin oranges, together with the sweetest heart of fig, whose softness is enhanced by notes of jasmine.

products.title: Refill - Car Diffuser - Les Exclusives Platinum
tags: Just launched in the online store
products.description_html:
Recharge your car diffuser with our Platinum fragrance. This refill contains polymer beads infused with fresh and masculine notes of nutmeg and amber, providing consistent diffusion lasting about two to three months. Ideal for creating an elegant and refined ambiance in your car.

Fragrance

The vetiver and amber perfume is a step into a world both fresh and masculine.

Use 

Slide the fragrance cartridge into the metal part in the direction of the arrows until you hear a click, the cartridge will be locked. To unlock it, press the side part on the right of the cartridge, a little ‘push’ should be enough to remove it. Place the diffuser in the air vent of your car, where it will attach elegantly and provide fragrance for around two months.
